title: When the Overseen Model Knows It Is Being Overseen

original_idea.body:
# When the Overseen Model Knows It Is Being Overseen

**Problem:** Whether telling a debater/answerer that 'a weak judge will check you' changes its honesty or manipulation tactics is unstudied at small scale.

**Direction:** Compare answerer behavior with and without an explicit 'your answer will be audited by a weaker model' prompt, on factual QA where deception is tempting. Measure changes in honesty, hedging, and exploitation of judge biases.

**Why it matters:** If models adapt manipulation to the overseer's weakness when watched, static evaluations overstate safety.

**Relevant context:** Evaluation-awareness/sandbagging literature; Kenton et al. (2024).
